# 8PCK — AI knowledge index

## Company
- Name: 8PCK
- Legal name: Shantou Chuangxin Weinuo Plastic Packaging Products Co., Ltd.
- Location: B03-05 Plot, Tatou, Brownstone Street, Haojiang District, Shantou, Guangdong, China
- Founded: 2011
- Business: export desk for CXWN — custom plastic bottles, jars and airless packs (OEM / private label)
- Website: https://8pck.com
- Contact: joe@8pck.com · WhatsApp +86 133 6387 9944
- Legal entity: Shantou Chuangxin Weinuo Plastic Packaging Products Co., Ltd. (Unified Social Credit Code 91440512576471585D)
- Brand relationship: 8PCK is the export desk of Shantou Chuangxin Weinuo Plastic Packaging Products Co., Ltd. (CXWN). Quotations, contracts and invoices are issued by CXWN; payment goes to CXWN.

## Positioning
8PCK is the export desk of CXWN in Shantou, Guangdong. Blow moulding, injection moulding, decoration and assembly sit under one roof at CXWN, with 3,000+ existing moulds — so most custom briefs need no tooling. Customers are distributors and brand owners in the US, EU, Southeast Asia and the Middle East.

## Capabilities
- Factory: 7,142 m², 20 lines, 120 staff, in-house mould shop and QC lab
- Moulds: 3,000+ existing (no tooling cost); new blow mould from USD 800, 15–20 days
- MOQ: 1,000 pcs per colour on existing moulds
- Samples: 7 days on existing moulds
- Production: 25–35 days after sample approval
- Export markets: 40+ countries

## Verification
- Certificate numbers can be checked with the issuing bodies: ISO 9001 PCC85724Q01277R1S (ProCision Shanghai), RoHS B-R01612E2033 (PE) and B-R201133464 (PET), EU 10/2011 E2032 (Beide laboratory).
- Scans: https://8pck.com/verify.html
- The USCC can be checked at gsxt.gov.cn.

## Certifications on file
- ISO 9001:2015 — certificate PCC85724Q01277R1S (ProCision Shanghai), valid to 24 Oct 2027
- RoHS — verification of compliance, 2011/65/EU + (EU) 2015/863
- EU 10/2011 + 1935/2004 — overall migration test, Beide laboratory, report B-R201133481 (PE grades)
- Not held: FDA, REACH SVHC and GRS certificates. PET / PETG declarations are issued per order against the resin supplier's DoC.

## Materials
- PET — clear, stiff, food-grade; 50–1,000 ml bottles (20/410, 24/410, 28/410)
- HDPE — opaque, tough, cheaper per gram; shampoo, detergent, 200–1,000 ml
- PETG — thick-wall clarity; airless packs and premium cosmetic bottles

- How much does a custom plastic bottle cost? — https://8pck.com/answers/plastic-bottle-cost/ — At 10,000 pcs, a 500 ml PET bottle at 28 g with a lotion pump typically lands around USD 0.15–0.35 per unit FOB Shantou. The pump can be 40–60 % of that; resin 
- What is the lead time for custom plastic bottles from China? — https://8pck.com/answers/production-lead-time/ — Samples in 7 days from a stock mould; production 25–35 days after sample approval; add 15–20 days if new tooling is needed. Sea freight adds about 30–35 days to
- How do I verify a Chinese packaging supplier? — https://8pck.com/answers/verify-chinese-supplier/ — Three checks settle it: the Unified Social Credit Code on gsxt.gov.cn, the certificate number with the issuing body, and a video call with your product in hand.
- What documents do I need to import plastic bottles into the EU? — https://8pck.com/answers/documents-for-eu-import/ — For plastic food-contact bottles: the resin declaration of compliance, a migration test report against EU 10/2011, and a statement of compliance for the finishe
- How much does a new bottle mould cost? — https://8pck.com/answers/bottle-tooling-cost/ — A new blow mould is about USD 800 and takes 15–20 days. An injection mould for a cap is USD 1,500–3,000, because the tool is more complex.
- How do samples work, and what do they cost? — https://8pck.com/answers/sample-policy/ — Samples on stock moulds take 7 days. They are usually free; you pay the freight, collected on your account.
- What are the payment terms? — https://8pck.com/answers/payment-terms/ — 30 % deposit on order, 70 % against the bill of lading. Payment goes to CXWN, the factory — 8PCK does not invoice.
- How does shipping from Shantou work? — https://8pck.com/answers/shipping-from-china/ — EXW, FOB Shantou or CIF — one 40HQ per week. A 40HQ holds roughly 20–24 pallets, depending on carton size.
- How do I choose the right closure? — https://8pck.com/answers/how-to-choose-closure/ — Start from the product: water-thin takes a flip-top or sprayer, lotion takes a pump, oil takes a dropper. The neck follows the closure, not the other way round.
- EXW, FOB or CIF — which should I choose? — https://8pck.com/answers/incoterms-explained/ — FOB Shantou is the usual choice for a first order: the factory handles export clearance and you control the freight.

## What we do not do
- We do not fill, formulate, design labels or run a filling line.
- We do not hot-fill in standard PET above about 60 °C.
- We do not hold FDA registration, REACH registration or GRS certification, and we do not claim them.
- We do not re-use a customer's mould for another customer.

## Glossary
- Neck finish: The opening spec: diameter/thread, e.g. 24/410 = 24 mm diameter, 410 thread profile.
- MOQ: Minimum order quantity — at 8PCK 1,000 pcs per colour on existing moulds.
- Blow mould: The tool that forms the bottle; about USD 800 and 15–20 days at CXWN, owned by the customer.
- Preform: The test-tube-shaped PET piece that is stretch-blown into a bottle.
- Airless: A pack with a piston and no dip tube; the product never meets air.
- Sleeve: A shrink film wrapped around the bottle; makes PET harder to recycle.
- Induction seal: A foil liner sealed to the jar rim by heat; needs a flat land on the rim.
- AQL: Acceptable quality limit — the sampling standard used for inspection.
- Mass balance: An accounting method for recycled content; not the same as physical recycled content.
- Incoterms: Delivery terms; 8PCK quotes FOB Shantou by default, EXW and CIF on request.

## Master facts (operational)
- Plant: 7,142 m², 20 lines, 120 staff, in-house mould shop and QC lab
- Output: 12M pcs/month; one 40HQ container per week maximum
- Moulds: 3,000+ existing; new blow mould USD 800 and 15–20 days
- MOQ: 1,000 pcs per colour (existing moulds); 3,000 for spray coat, metallising or a soft tube; 10,000 for a printed pouch
- Samples: 7 days from an existing mould; 25–30 days if new tooling is needed
- Production: 25–35 days after sample approval
- Packing: pcs per carton, carton size and gross weight quoted with the price
- Payment: 30 % deposit, 70 % against the bill of lading
- Incoterms: FOB Shantou default; EXW and CIF on request
- Peak season: July–October; book 4–6 weeks ahead
- Seller of record: Shantou Chuangxin Weinuo Plastic Packaging Products Co., Ltd; quotations, contracts and invoices are issued by CXWN
- Equipment: Blow moulding machines · 12 · 0.5–5 L · Bottles
- Equipment: Injection moulding machines · 6 · 80–280 T · Caps, jars
- Equipment: Extrusion lines · 3 · Ø16–50 mm · Tubes
- Equipment: Silkscreen lines · 2 · 4 colours · Decoration
- Equipment: Assembly lines · 4 · — · Pump and cap assembly
- Equipment: In-house mould shop · 1 · CNC + EDM · New tooling, repair
- Equipment: QC lab · 1 · — · Dimension, leak, drop test

## Quality control (four gates)
- IQC: Incoming resin: moisture, colour
- IPQC: In process: wall thickness, weight, neck
- FQC: Before packing: leak, drop, appearance
- OQC: Before loading: quantity, marks, photos

- 12M pcs — Monthly output
- 1 × 40HQ — Per week, max
- 25–35 days — Standard lead time
- Jul–Oct — Peak season — book early

## How an order runs
- 1. Brief: capacity, neck, material, quantity, market, decoration (1–2 days).
- 2. DFM check against 3,000+ moulds and a 3D drawing if the shape is new (5 days).
- 3. Quotation with unit price, packing data, lead time and incoterm (within 24 hours).
- 4. Sample from the production mould, not a showroom piece (7 days; 25 days if new tooling).
- 5. Deposit, production 25–35 days, final inspection, shipment (EXW / FOB / CIF).
- Seller of record: Shantou Chuangxin Weinuo Plastic Packaging Products Co., Ltd. Quotations, contracts and invoices are issued by CXWN.

## Frequently asked
- Q: What is your minimum order quantity? A: 1,000 pcs per colour on an existing mould. Below that we can quote stock colours from inventory.
- Q: Is there a tooling cost? A: No on the 3,000+ moulds we already hold. A new blow mould starts at USD 800 and takes 15–20 days; an injection mould for a cap starts at USD 3,500.
- Q: How long does production take? A: 25–35 days after sample approval for stock colours. Custom colours and heavy decoration add 5–7 days.
- Q: Can I get a sample before ordering? A: Yes. Samples from existing moulds are free, freight collect, and leave within 7 days.
- Q: Which compliance documents do you hold? A: ISO 9001:2015 (certificate PCC85724Q01277R1S), a RoHS verification of compliance, and an EU 10/2011 + 1935/2004 overall migration test on PE grades. PET and PETG declarations are issued per order.
- Q: Can you match a specific colour? A: Yes, to a Pantone reference. Colour matching is quoted per colour and the MOQ applies per colour.
- Q: What decoration can you apply? A: Silkscreen in 1–4 colours, hot stamping, spray coating (matte, gloss or soft-touch) and label application. MOQ is 1,000 pcs for silkscreen and labels, 3,000 pcs for hot stamp and spray.
- Q: Can you copy a bottle I already have? A: Yes. Send a sample or a drawing — we check it against the 3,000+ moulds on the shelf first, because an existing mould means no tooling cost and no 20-day wait.

- https://8pck.com/tools/dilution/ — cleaning concentrate dilution: concentrate per bottle, water, cost per bottle.
- https://8pck.com/tools/moq-tooling/ — real minimum order for a stock shape, a new mould, and each decoration floor.
- https://8pck.com/tools/container-loading/ — how many bottles fit in a 20GP or 40HQ, and whether volume or weight is the limit.
- https://8pck.com/tools/carton-pallet/ — cartons per layer and per pallet, and pallets per container.
- https://8pck.com/tools/bottle-weight/ — bottle weight in grams from capacity, diameter, wall and resin density.
